params.body: Dear Vendor-1, We are experiencing a temporary issue with processing your payment. The payment of 30 for the invoice correction-E5-221027 has been denied due to a budget limitation. We are currently working on resolving this issue and will inform you of the progress. Thank you for your understanding.

Dear Vendor-1,

We are currently facing a scope limitation that prevents us from processing the payment for the invoice correction-E5-221027. We are working on resolving this issue and will inform you as soon as it is resolved. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
